pages.title: A Traveller's Wings
pages.text: The metallic feathers of a Stymphalian bird remain sharp after being shed. Made into a charm, they turn some of the hurt back on the attacker.$(br2)The wings stand for a traveller's longing for freedom. Whatever dangers lie ahead, there is still a world beyond.

pages.title: A Wound Answered
pages.text: When an attack costs your companion health, the charm deals 25%% of the health lost back to the attacker, up to 8 damage per hit. Environmental damage and hits that cost no health do not trigger it.$(br2)It never retaliates against the owner or allies. It cannot be worn with a Warding Thornfeather Emblem.
